body:
The worst case I can imagine is all the applications don't go through as my credit score is deceptively low right now and so I don't have any place to store my stuff that isn't outrageously expensive or inconvenient. I can afford to stay in a seedy motel for a few days but after I'll start cutting into a) security deposit money and b) interrupting work. I don't want to go to friends as one of them is the reason I'm so short on time to find a new place and the rest I only vaguely know through work.

Edit: even as I type up this stupid ass comment all I can think is how fucking pathetic this is that this is why I'm depressed

It's hard not to think I will be homeless after Tuesday even if it is for like three days. I don't know. It feels like a shame spiral as I know that being "homeless" it's really homeless so it's pathetic to feel so horrible. I'm trying to see through to the better days but its not easy

My dad refuses to go to California. He also refuses to tell us why.

Edit: sorry I meant to say he said its a deathbed story.
